pr.title: Bind Issue execution and delivery to current supervisor admission
pr.body:
Refs ed3c/soodles#18

Issue execution and delivery previously could lose the original continuation context after stale admission or missing owner readback, leaving an Agent to guess a recovery entry. This change binds automatic, supervised and worker consumers to the shared Issue admission validator before effects; preserves the invoked operation, supervisor-owned missing inputs and canonical Noodle identity; and rechecks the binding before provider delivery and final reconciliation.

A current whole-body/revision binding, exact starting head, allowed write paths and measured carrier are required. Repeated admission preserves the original order, a live writer blocks takeover, and provider closure cannot resolve an incomplete original Noodle order. The verification map now describes only the physically observed bounded execution and handoff.

Validation:
- 63 focused controls passed; 11 planted defects made the same controls RED, followed by cure GREEN and legal non-case GREEN.
- Real macOS Noodle scheduler and Codex worker executed the controls at 847f3f8, emitted their own matching typed blocked outcome, and stopped. Live-writer takeover was refused; the later quiescent supervised handoff reused the same order without publication.
- Final candidate 4d9e756: [canonical runtime acceptance](https://github.com/ed3c/soodles/actions/runs/35127342835) and [independent runtime feature/acceptance readback](https://github.com/ed3c/soodles/actions/runs/35127778615) passed.
- The final landing continuation correction and map edits have their own final-head acceptance; the earlier worker trace is not relabelled as final-head execution.

Delivery uses the externally pinned landing owner and its fresh next/request projections. The historical /opt carrier failure, general production scheduling, and A → cleanup → B continuity remain outside this bounded success. Provider merge, closure and Noodle cleanup require their own readbacks before RESOLVED.

issue.title: Admit one Soodles Issue into Noodle execution and receipted delivery
issue.body:
## Current contract — 2026-09-16

This is the single current specification for this Issue. Historical status and experiment records are preserved [verbatim at an immutable commit](https://github.com/ed3c/soodles/blob/88a50fe29ce2ea2477ab709914494c37ad4230db/evidence/18/current-contract/issue-before.md). Historical paragraphs do not select current scope, dependencies, authorization or next actions.

The owner requested this order: **shared admission contract plus real consumers → one complete Issue using existing owner next/request → A delivered and cleaned up, then B, with one specified interruption/recovery**. The last step is the subsequent milestone, not permission to split this causal correction into parser/helper Issues or silently widen this atom.

### Current state and evidence ceiling

- Implementation is now committed at `0bbdd1097fb95a86c935329e0867750224877ace` in [draft PR #38](https://github.com/ed3c/soodles/pull/38). The shared validator, automatic/supervised entries, worker revalidation, delivery binding and quiescent-process readback have source and 61 focused local controls. Eight planted enforcement removals fail their same controls, which pass again after restoration. [Exact-head Linux canonical acceptance](https://github.com/ed3c/soodles/actions/runs/35120713563) succeeded. These results do not establish full live integration or landing authority.
- The owner has requested proceeding with this work. Carrier capability must be evaluated for the environment that will actually execute this Issue. The old /opt carrier remains unproven; the owner has selected the physically verified macOS identity. No production execution envelope, order, worker or source change was installed by this contract consolidation.
- Noodle #80 is **closed/delivered** through PR #81, merge `1ba241abb68333b5c53d9d23955f538b2cb63877`. It is not an open blocker.
- [Noodle #78](https://github.com/ed3c/noodle/issues/78) is now delivered through [PR #79](https://github.com/ed3c/noodle/pull/79), merge `9cdb919826eb6ef25bbb47978ae4d398332cb9ed`. Its current contract selects the physically verified macOS carrier. [Capability receipt and all traces](https://github.com/ed3c/noodle/tree/2e166473c4939f88fc55db3b78d96b85459ff728/evidence/78/macos-process-dispatch) and [provider delivery/Noodle reconciliation](https://github.com/ed3c/noodle/tree/4c621216d23c03d7fe2a0d6e758f9b32aa6141c8/evidence/78/delivery) were published and read back byte-for-byte. The old `/opt` initialization failure remains historical/unresolved and is not a blocker for this selected carrier.
- **Delivered owner prerequisite (historical gap retained):** the actual Noodle proposal consumer changes failed work back to active when old initial-proposal bytes are replayed. [Executed observer and raw failure](https://github.com/ed3c/soodles/tree/1d022e875bd06f3ce51a9c41525d43154b93fbc1/evidence/18/order-boundary). This is a RED baseline for this Issue's required initial-admission semantics; legacy Noodle scheduling previously permits explicit restart/amendment. [Noodle #82](https://github.com/ed3c/noodle/issues/82) delivered the conditional initial-admission boundary through merged PR #83 in that separate repository. Do not add a Soodles lock/ledger or rely on producer check-then-create.
- ChatGPT-supervised GitHub transport and Actions Noodle worktree runtime already work. They do not transfer this conversation's inference runtime/context/login into Actions, and do not prove nested Agent execution. #78 is not a blanket blocker for that already-demonstrated supervised Actions route. No API-key-only prerequisite is reinstated.
- [This consolidation's readback receipt](https://github.com/ed3c/soodles/blob/88a50fe29ce2ea2477ab709914494c37ad4230db/evidence/18/current-contract/receipt.json) records the admitted binary check, source/provider observations and explicit non-claims. It is not a new Agent or delivery proof.

## Goal and owner

One Soodles target-adapter correction: an explicitly authorized real Issue becomes exactly one Noodle-owned order/worktree, executes within its admitted boundary, passes the existing verification and provider handoff, and ends with provider merge/closure plus local reconciliation.

The Soodles Issue-admission owner is prospective. Do not confuse it with the already-implemented landing checkpoint owner. Noodle retains canonical order ownership, runtime and worktree lifecycle. Existing landing retains provider-write intent and reconciliation. The GitHub connector remains the supervised transport.

## One Issue input contract

Automatic scheduling and supervised entry consume the same repository-owned validator and normalized result. The human-readable template and machine consumer must agree; a template or two fixture wrappers alone is not completion.

The active Issue format carries:
1. Causal trigger and source/evidence identity.
2. One owner and reversible change boundary.
3. Requested changes and exact authorized write boundary, bound to the supervisor's envelope.
4. Required observable behavior, defect control, corrected behavior and a legal non-case.
5. Exact dependencies, their owners and current evidence requirements.
6. Canonical acceptance, provider delivery and local reconciliation requirements.
7. Existing feature-map coverage and explicit non-claims.

Repository/Issue identity and current body revision/digest are derived from provider readback, not guessed or copied from an obsolete paragraph. Body digest binds bytes; it cannot supply authorization. The executing route is fixed by admitted environment/capability, not an Agent-selected policy flag. Missing authority/input requires its owning source, never an invented value.

Keep one active contract in the body; preserve historical receipts by immutable link. Under the current whole-body binding requirement, a body amendment invalidates the old binding. Do not silently exempt selected paragraphs from revision checking.

## PR and delivery contract

Preserve the implemented exact `Refs ed3c/soodles#<issue>` relationship. Do not add closing keywords that bypass the landing owner's explicit closure transition.

PR prose describes the problem, change, validation and limits. It does not grant authority. Repository/head/base/tree/worktree and run/attempt identities come from actual Git/provider observations and the existing claim, not hand-entered PR summaries. A green check's reported state and provider enforcement of a required-check rule are different claims.

## Real consumers and effect boundaries

1. Validate the same Issue identity/body revision/authorization/write boundary before automatic order publication or supervised execution, and again before worker task effects. Both real entry surfaces must consume the shared result.
2. Use existing `orders-next` and Noodle canonical ownership. Prove actual producer/consumer interleavings and interruption do not create another order or accidentally request a restart/amendment. A check-then-create race or a second lock/ledger is not sufficient.
3. Automatic-to-supervised takeover first obtains owner evidence that the prior writer is quiescent/contained. Preserve original order, claim, checkpoint and offered-write history. A still-running writer must refuse takeover before effects.
4. Amendments invalidate the old execution envelope before new effects. Wider same-cause writes require the amended Issue and fresh envelope; later candidate changes use existing landing invalidate/readmit. Unknown provider outcomes allow only owner readback.
5. Preserve old landing checkpoints for their original recovery semantics. Missing new bindings do not authorize new execution. Do not auto-migrate prose into authorization.
6. Check actual changed paths before handoff/landing, including deletion/rename endpoints and invalid path forms. This proves bounded delivery, not confinement of every filesystem action; stronger pre-effect confinement needs its own demonstrated boundary.
7. The consumer follows the invoked owner's current `owner/action/next/invalid/request`. Known arguments are supplied by their owner; missing inputs identify their source. Historical next output is not authority. Re-entering an operation rechecks eligibility. Only the exact emitted connector request is transported.
8. Preserve final-head canonical acceptance, exact-head provider evidence, explicitly fixed external verifier, merge/closure readback and Noodle reconciliation. Candidate changes never promote their own verifier. A successful stage, exit code or null next alone is not RESOLVED.

No second scheduler, worktree manager, retry engine, policy-selection flag or copied skill state machine.

## Gate acceptance: defect RED / cure GREEN / legal non-case GREEN

Each new gate has a concrete failure it distinguishes. These are required observations, **not results already obtained**.

RED/GREEN describes the outcome of the control, not the provider status or the gate's allow/deny answer. Correctly rejecting an illegal request is a GREEN control. For RED, the old implementation or a narrowly planted removal of the relevant enforcement must make that same control fail; then the cure must make it pass, while the nearest legal non-case also passes.

| Boundary | Defect RED: control catches the defect | Cure GREEN: same control passes | Legal non-case GREEN |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Issue admission | Absent/bypassed binding lets missing/malformed input, foreign identity, stale body or unauthorized writes reach effects; the control fails | Current guard rejects those inputs before effects and admits the exact authorized contract | Equivalent valid input through both routes produces the same binding; prose presentation does not add unrelated rejection rules |
| Order ownership | Duplicate/stale publication or interrupted replay creates another order or restarts owned failed work; the control fails | Canonical ownership prevents that extra effect and admits the first eligible work once | A different independently authorized Issue can enter when eligible |
| Worker entry | Absent/bypassed revalidation lets stale admission start task effects; the control fails | Stale input is refused and current exact admission starts the intended real worker | Missing local nested-Agent capability does not reject separately admitted supervised runtime-only work |
| Takeover | Absent/bypassed takeover guard allows a live prior writer, reset history or replayed unknown offer; the control fails | Quiescent-owner takeover preserves identity/history and refuses unsafe cases | A valid prepared-but-unoffered continuation can proceed |
| Delivery boundary | Absent/bypassed delivery binding accepts out-of-envelope paths or obsolete-head evidence; the control fails | Exact candidate passes and invalid paths/evidence are refused | Legitimate in-boundary rename/deletion and fresh readmission remain possible |
| Terminal transition | Premature terminal logic declares RESOLVED from CI green, emitted request or closure alone; the control fails | RESOLVED requires provider merge/closure plus actual Noodle/local reconciliation | Existing valid checkpoint recovery remains supported without granting new execution authority |

For R, bind the test to the actual provider-enforced subject and restriction, and distinguish a provider rejection/readback from a local mock. Do not weaken production protections merely to obtain RED; use the existing defect evidence or a controlled authorized test subject. A fixture alone cannot establish provider enforcement.

Controls must assert the invalid field/value, owning next input/readback and absent forbidden effects. Correct erroneous code and tests together within this causal atom; retain discriminating controls rather than preserving wrong assertions. L/R failure handling must not require the Agent to guess identity, policy, state or a recovery command. An explicit justified refusal is still required.

## N/P/L/R: classify claims and their enforcement

- **N — non-claim:** description, inventory, metrics, historical summaries and unverified plans. No correctness or delivery authority.
- **P — probabilistic guidance:** reasoning, skills, prompts and method/path choice. Cannot replace executable enforcement.
- **L — local deterministic gate:** executable discrimination bound to subject, controls, readback and necessary residue checks. May reject; does not prove defect-free software.
- **R — provider-enforced readback:** actual provider restrictions and observed exact-subject state. Does not independently prove local reconciliation or complete behavior.

These are not file types, confidence scores or promotion stages. One artifact can contain differently scoped statements; provenance and the executed control decide the claim. Neither repeated green results nor a new default-branch tip promotes N/P into L/R.

## Complete acceptance for this Issue

- Both actual entry surfaces consume the same validator; invalid input is rejected at the owning boundary before effects.
- Real automatic dispatch obtains Agent-produced session/order/stage-bound outcome; actual automatic-to-supervised recovery preserves identity/history. Fixtures and supervised success cannot substitute for this route.
- Nearest positive, planted-defect and legal non-case controls; canonical acceptance once on the final candidate; exact-head provider gate under the fixed external publisher.
- One actual admitted Issue through worktree, execution, verification, PR handoff, merge/close readback, Noodle reconciliation and RESOLVED.
- After physical proof, extend the existing verify-soodles map and perform full pstack maintenance. No speculative automatic recipe, copied feature-map-engineering layer or claim of lower decision cost from command count alone.

The [prior admission baseline](https://github.com/ed3c/soodles/blob/6f29e580279b1d4b1d29725794c8121476c3b770/evidence/18/admission-baseline/baseline.json) is explicitly real CLI over provider fixtures: missing/empty/undeclared body was admitted by the existing landing owner; changed body still allowed request emission, not transport. It demonstrates the missing execution-admission boundary, not a production incident or an existing-contract regression.

## Following milestone: A → cleanup → B, with one interruption

Only after the single-Issue integration is demonstrated:
- Select two genuinely needed, authorized Issues; do not split one causal fix or manufacture maintenance work to produce a count.
- A reaches provider delivery and local RESOLVED, with branch/worktree cleanup and surviving evidence.
- Without another human instruction, the existing owner selects B, revalidates its current contract/authorization and provider-confirmed base, and creates the appropriate Noodle-owned work.
- B also reaches complete delivery/reconciliation. A's code changes do not automatically select a new trusted verifier for B.
- Inject one specifically named process interruption, initially at durable prepared-before-offered intent; resume the same identity/checkpoint to completion and preserve evidence.
- Treat offered-before-emission/network ambiguity separately: unmerged readback alone does not prove non-delivery. Safe BLOCKED is not a successful automatic recovery. No remote exactly-once claim.
- Reject premature B, stale B, duplicate notification and still-running prior writer without new forbidden effects.
- Record route, intervention points, real post-delivery defects, rework, elapsed time and observable cost. Unknown is not zero; two deliveries prove this scenario, not long-term rates.

This milestone does not add speculative concurrency, model routing or self-improvement to #18.

## Selected implementation boundary — 2026-09-16

The owner requested implementation on the physically verified macOS carrier. Noodle #82/PR #83 now supplies the real initial-admission precondition (merge `656e9ec73689c523058750e8b0a2388a15bb84fa`, tree `b66dfbbba4cdf015e988b17e8babdc45c3aade2d`); its delivery readback and cleanup are complete: https://github.com/ed3c/noodle/tree/3f1c0887ed3a9e3544c4d108a6c896b94cb5e05b/evidence/82/delivery . Its fixed local [controls](https://github.com/ed3c/noodle/tree/e7d37d4bf5dc6005f5d1eb5e342c4b97e4749442/evidence/82/initial-admission) do not substitute for this Issue's real automatic consumer.

Freeze this same-atom initial source boundary before edits:
- `.gitignore`
- `soodles.py`
- `issue_admission.py`
- `issue_execution.py`
- `landing.py`
- `tests/test_issue_admission.py`
- `tests/test_issue_execution.py`
- `tests/test_landing.py`
- `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/execution.yml`
- `.agents/skills/schedule/SKILL.md`
- `.agents/skills/execute/SKILL.md`

Base: `50f41919ead671d69eade1ae5cc66bd1d96e347c`. Implementation uses the Noodle-owned worktree `soodles-18-0-execute`, preserving the main checkout. This worktree name is the existing Noodle stage naming form and is accepted by the existing landing owner. A source-boundary expansion requires amendment before edits.

The prospective deployment envelope is supervisor-supplied outside the candidate and binds exact provider Issue/body bytes, owner, allowed file paths, source base, control/worktree/order identity and measured executable identities. An Issue digest, template, copied environment name or candidate-generated JSON grants no authority. The native #82 binary is SHA-256 `c299d2bce4e33ddd0b1c6295bd3cbeb1d29b32782fdcc9bcc9ffac2cf87ab35c`; Codex remains the verified #78 identity. Full nested execution on this newly integrated subject still must be observed. `policy/runtime.lock.json` and existing Linux canonical acceptance remain unchanged in this source boundary; if reconciliation needs a bound native runtime, it must validate the separately supervised execution envelope without broadening legacy lock semantics.

The shared parser uses one marked JSON execution-contract block with free surrounding prose; the entire provider body remains digest-bound. The repository Issue template and both real consumers use this same schema. New CLI inspection receipts are non-authorizing. Both real routes use Noodle's current canonical ownership and initial-admission contract; worker revalidation happens before launching the actual task. No active production order/worker is installed merely by this scope selection.

## Next owner action and stop condition

#78 and #82 capability/owner delivery are read back. The real Noodle → Codex scheduler invoked the pinned automatic admission launcher, but the selected child carrier refused `api.github.com` because the domain is not on its sandbox allowlist. No `soodles-18` order, target worker or matching task outcome was produced. Read-only diagnosis now identifies the existing user-owned `agent-default` profile as the domain-rule owner: it already allows `api.github.com`. The supervisor-created launcher's legacy `--sandbox workspace-write` selection prevented that named profile from being selected. Correct and freshly bind the launcher selection before another launch; do not request a new domain permission or assume an enterprise administrator is the blocker. All five observed scheduler process groups are absent; the historical failed schedule checkpoint is preserved and installed mode is manual. Do not restart unchanged input or route around the denial. This body amendment invalidates both experimental execution-envelope body bindings; a later continuation requires a fresh externally selected envelope including the current exact starting `execution.source_head`. Preserve the original worktree and existing owner history. Complete actual worker execution, supervised recovery, final exact-head checks and provider delivery/reconciliation before resolution.

Do not repeat unchanged Codex bootstrap, request an API key as a blanket prerequisite, use two fixtures as real consumers, or label contract consolidation as implementation. The already-demonstrated supervised Actions route remains valid within its evidence ceiling.

The separate [skill-concerns #197](https://github.com/ed3c/skill-concerns/issues/197) empty-ledger monitor finding retains its own owner. It is not a new prerequisite or an implicit expansion of this atom.

## Implementation and blocked live boundary — 2026-09-17

[Immutable receipt, fixed controls and complete selected traces](https://github.com/ed3c/soodles/blob/3dffb402c1a5dfd55eeeb89ba1cc724de03e7fda/evidence/18/implementation-20260917/receipt.json) were published at `3dffb402c1a5dfd55eeeb89ba1cc724de03e7fda`; all 128 referenced files were read back byte-for-byte. The physical scheduler attempts used frozen source `fa45a099` and `b3850ee`; the final `0bbdd109` head has local controls and Linux Actions proof, not a claimed physical task-worker success. The first carrier had a child DNS failure; after explicit workspace-write network selection, enforcement identified the domain allowlist refusal. No alternate network route, parent-created outcome, merge/close request or production cleanup was used. The original allowlist-owner uncertainty is superseded by the configuration diagnosis below; the failed physical traces remain valid historical evidence.

The final worktree is clean, main remains `50f41919ead671d69eade1ae5cc66bd1d96e347c`, PR #38 remains draft/unmerged, and #18 remains OPEN. Preliminary PR #37 is closed as superseded, not merged. The verification feature map and A → cleanup → B interruption milestone remain pending physical single-Issue integration.


## Network-policy owner identified — 2026-09-17

[Read-back diagnosis receipt](https://github.com/ed3c/soodles/blob/9acd3aaa2006ed22b56835feaa24ee748c6ca28a/evidence/18/network-owner-20260917/receipt.json): Codex 0.153.4 `config/read` attributes `permissions.agent-default.network.domains.api.github.com = "allow"` and `features.network_proxy = true` to the user layer `/Users/neon/.codex/config.toml`. `configRequirements/read` returns `requirements: null`. That configuration file predates the failed scheduler runs.

The causal integration error is the supervisor-created carrier launcher: its explicit legacy `--sandbox workspace-write` selects the older settings instead of a named permissions profile. Official permission-profile semantics confirm this precedence. A separate read-only configuration load selecting `default_permissions = "agent-default"`, without legacy sandbox keys, reads back the existing GitHub allow rule and enabled proxy. No thread, model turn, tool request, network probe, source edit or persistent permission change was started by this diagnosis.

Next correction belongs to the Soodles supervisor/launcher, using the existing authorized profile and a fresh exact-source/execution envelope. Merely deleting `--sandbox` is insufficient: the unrelated global default is broader. Preserve filtering and validate the complete new argv and required runtime write roots. Configuration selection is not a successful live admission or a matching typed outcome; #18 remains open and #38 draft until those are demonstrated.


## Session intent, context handoff and continuation audit — 2026-09-17

The owner clarified the desired interaction: express intent in the supervising Session; preserve observations and scoped evidence in this causal Issue; use existing owners to carry the admitted task through physical delivery and reconciliation. Each completed atom requires its own scoped closed-loop evidence. This is a completion criterion, not a claim that every existing Issue already passed.

Context flow: Session interpretation (P) → current Issue intent/requirements and evidence index (N) → separately supervisor-selected execution envelope and shared admission (L) → existing Noodle order/worktree/session → explicit stage prompt projection plus selected skill/repository contract (P) → revalidated worker, Agent-produced typed outcome and observer readback → fixed external verification → existing landing next/request → connector transport and exact provider readbacks (R) → local reconciliation and scoped terminal decision (L consuming R and local observations). The child is not assumed to inherit this Session's conversation, authority, credentials or inference context. Only the explicit carried inputs are available; hashes bind identity and do not supply missing meaning or authorization.

N/P/L/R classify specific claims and enforcement, not successive confidence levels. An Issue's summary of a test remains an evidence index; executable discriminator and raw scoped observations support L, actual provider state/restrictions support R. A merged PR readback does not by itself prove required-check enforcement, local cleanup or complete behavior. Classification belongs to the boundary contract/receipt; the Agent need not relabel each operation.

L/R may legitimately stop work. They must identify the invalid subject/value, missing input, its supplying owner and the existing continuation entry, preserving known identity/checkpoint and forbidden-effect constraints. They must not make the Agent invent identity, authorization, state, permissions, recovery commands or replacement checkpoints. Unknown provider writes require readback; a continuation entry is not permission to resend or retry unchanged input.

**New micro-observation, not full integration proof:** [immutable probe and receipt](https://github.com/ed3c/soodles/blob/347be45b2b91ed03b565b34c05e3c62deb85d2ae/evidence/18/context-flow-20260917/receipt.json), both files read back byte-for-byte, against candidate `0bbdd1097fb95a86c935329e0867750224877ace`. Actual automatic/supervised admission functions were invoked with explicit provider/owner fixtures. Both rejected a changed Issue body before proposal/worker effects (rejection control GREEN); both admitted the original legitimate body (legal non-case GREEN). Their refusal outputs provided `invalid`, `next.owner` and `next.required`, but no explicit `next.operation` or supported continuation entry/help. The separate continuation-guidance control is therefore RED on the existing implementation. Cure and same-control GREEN are not implemented/tested. The owner label alone does not prove that the named owner supplies the complete remedy. Fixture cleanup passed; no live Agent or provider write was exercised by this probe.

The existing 21 admission/execution tests also passed via unittest discovery. An initial package-style invocation could not import the sibling test helper; switching to the repository's discovery layout resolved that invocation error without source changes. These tests do not cover the full continuation requirement and their GREEN does not erase the new RED.

This gap belongs to #18's existing consumer/output boundary, not a new scheduler or separate helper Issue. Preserve the same-control RED → cure GREEN and legal non-case GREEN when correcting it. Full live worker/outcome, automatic-to-supervised recovery and provider delivery/reconciliation remain pending. This body amendment invalidates prior whole-body execution bindings; the next execution requires a fresh external binding after the current contract is settled.
